results.title: Uranium poised for long-term structural deficit as AI boom spurs unprecedented nuclear demand
results.description: With nuclear reactor builds currently outpacing new uranium mine supply and the rapid growth of AI and data centres is reinforcing the need for large-scale baseload power, uranium's investment case does not rest on sentiment, finds Canadian uranium explorer Purecore in an investor report. Drawing on insights from International Energy Agency (IEA), International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), US Energy Information Administration (EIA), Sprott Asset Management and Cameco Corporation, Purecore highlights a timing imbalance between the rapid development of AI infrastructure and the longer development timelines associated with new uranium mines.
creator: marleny arnoldi

results.title: US tells Gulf countries to prepare for possible strike on Iran after midterms Report
results.description: Washington Oct 28 IANS The United States has told several Gulf countries to prepare for a brief but intense military campaign against Iran after the US midterm elections The Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday citing people briefed on the conversationsnbspAccording to the report the United States and Israel are preparing for another round of intense military operations against Iran US forces in the Middle East are replenishing ammunition stocks and bombers and fighter jets are getting ready for potential strikesIsrael has also drawn up plans and identified targets for a possible new attack the Journal reportednbspUS President Donald Trump has not made a final decision but is leaning toward a major attack targeting Iranian infrastructure and nuclear sites the report said Xinhua News Agency reportednbspTrump could also seek a deal with Iran Last week he said the United States might launch another little Epic Fury referring to the US and Israeli bombing campaign in the spring or Iran could agree to a dealThe president has said he wont attack Iran before the midtermsnbspLast week Trump warned that American forces could launch another round of military strikes against Iran if Tehran fails to reach an agreement with Washington signalling that further military action remains an option despite his claims that Iran has already suffered a decisive defeatnbspSpeaking at a Republican campaign rally in Fort Myers Florida Trump suggested that the United States could repeat elements of its military campaign against Iran if diplomatic efforts failed to produce an agreementWe may do another little Epic Fury or theyll agree If theyre smart theyll just say lets get down to business Trump told supportersnbspThe remarks came as the President sought to portray the military campaign as successful while keeping pressure on Tehran to accept an agreement that would prevent it from developing nuclear weaponsnbspTrump referred to two American military operations against Iran Operation Midnight Hammer and Operation Epic Fury claiming they had destroyed the countrys nuclear enrichment capabilities and severely weakened its military and economyWe obliterated Irans nuclear enrichment capacity with Operation Midnight Hammer he saidnbspThe President said subsequent operations had reinforced the initial strikesnbspHe did not outline the conditions Iran would have to meet to prevent another round of military actionnbspWe defeated them militarily financially and otherwise and now we are ensuring its done Trump saidnbspHis comments suggested that Washington was prepared to maintain military pressure even as the administration considered the possibility of an agreementIANS
creator: dailyworld news desk
